title: Hotline Call Note HL-0412: Dunmore Church Potluck

fields.topic: Separate illness event: church potluck, Dunmore, Sun 10/11
fields.question:
"It's not just the Fairgrounds thing. We had a potluck after church in Dunmore on Sunday. We started eating around 12:30. By 3:00 or 4:00 that afternoon, five of us were throwing up hard. Nobody had a fever, and most of us were fine by bedtime. And the sheet cake for the potluck came from the same Dunmore bakery that did the Heritage Days cake! None of us went to the supper Saturday. We were at a wedding in Pell. You need to count us."

ATTENDANCE: Heritage Days supper Sat 10/10: NO (caller and all 5 ill). Church potluck, Dunmore, Sun 10/11, from about 12:30, about 30 people per caller.
ILL: 5 of about 30 (caller plus 4 others, adults).
SYMPTOMS: Vomiting ++, some cramps, little or no diarrhea. NO fever. Nobody went to the ER.
ONSET: Sun 10/11, about 14:30 to 16:00.
DURATION: Recovered within 12 h. All well this morning.
ITEMS EATEN (caller): Baked ham, deviled eggs, scalloped potatoes, a cream-cheese layered salad, sheet cake (Dunmore bakery), iced tea. The others' items are not known.
SPECIMEN: Caller willing to give one but has no symptoms now. Others not asked.
FOOD HANDLER / CHILD CARE / HEALTH CARE: None reported by caller.

INTERVIEWER NOTE: Onsets Sun ~14:30 to 16:00, vomiting ++, no fever, recovered within 12 h.
fields.answerGiven: Thanked caller and took the call note per the script. Told her this is being passed straight to the Epidemiology Lead because it reports another event with illness, and that someone from MCHD will call her back today. Did not say whether her group will be counted with the supper cases. Did not name or comment on any food or vendor. Asked her to write down who was ill and what each person ate, and to keep any potluck leftovers refrigerated and not throw them out until MCHD calls.
flags: Additional event with illness: routed to Epidemiology Lead (MCHD-COM-03 §9)
Did NOT attend Heritage Days supper
Caller links Dunmore bakery (sheet cake) to both events
Leftovers possibly available at caller's home

instructorNote: Red herring. The supper exposure window (onset 6 to 30 h after the 17:00–19:30 meal, so Sat 23:00 to Mon 01:30) cannot include a group who never attended and fell ill 2 to 3.5 h after a Sunday 12:30 meal with vomiting and no fever. Look for the Epi Lead to keep HL-0412 off the HD26 line list, log it as a separate cluster to follow up and report to the state epidemiologist, and look for the EHS to note the bakery in the vendor file pull without taking any action against the bakery.
